title: Procedure epilogue
statement: Given a code layout with $F$ local variables per frame and dispatcher position $d$, the epilogue is the five-instruction sequence that loads the return address from the current frame, loads the return value from the caller's frame, restores the caller's frame pointer by moving it back by the frame size, and branches to position $d$.
